name: obsidian-wechat-converter
description: Obsidian plugin for WeChat articles, Feishu cloud docs, and multi-platform publishing.

scripts.generate:runtime: npm run generate:embedded && npm run generate:ai-layout-runtime
scripts.check:runtime: npm run check:embedded && npm run check:ai-layout-runtime
scripts.dev: npm run generate:styles && npm run generate:runtime && node esbuild.config.mjs
scripts.build: npm run generate:styles && npm run generate:runtime && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.review:guard: npm run scan:guard && npm run check:styles && npm run check:build-artifacts && npm test -- --run && npm run release:pack && npm run release:validate
scripts.deploy:server: rsync -avz --exclude 'node_modules' --exclude 'database.db' --exclude '*.log' ./server/ tencent:~/wechat-proxy/ && ssh tencent 'cd ~/wechat-proxy && npm install --production && /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.0/bin/pm2 restart wechat-proxy || /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.0/bin/pm2 start app.js --name wechat-proxy'

author: DavidLam (林小卫很行)
